title: Site-Coverage Multiplier: Where a Late-Issued Certificate Serves
content:
# Site-coverage multiplier

> Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the hosting plan and the covered domain named on the certificate subscription, among the customer's Web Hosting Plans and Domain Registrations holdings.

**Clause.** The site-coverage multiplier of the late-issuance goodwill follows where the certificate serves: where the certificate is installed on an active Harborline hosting plan and covers an active Harborline domain, every Harborline plan's free domain-validated certificates kept the site encrypted and the multiplier is 0.75; where it is installed on no active Harborline plan and covers no active Harborline domain, the multiplier is 1.2; otherwise the multiplier is one. It multiplies the late-issuance goodwill figure.

| Installed on an active Harborline hosting plan | Covers an active Harborline domain | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.75 |
| no | no | 1.2 |
| yes | no | 1 |
| no | yes | 1 |
